_readme: Bot Checker list (/call-of-duty-mobile/bot-checker, read by codm-bots.js). One entry per bot name seen in CODM: name = exactly as it shows in game; mode = where it was seen ("mp" or "br"), optional; note = optional one line. Matching ignores upper/lower case, spaces and symbols, so "Bot_01" and "bot 01" are the same name. Entries with "example": true are placeholders added Oct 29 2026 so the page works before the real list is in: delete them when Adrian's list goes in. Update "updated" when the list changes (the banner shows it).
